summary: Add lifecycle and modular evolutionary Twin contracts

delivery.outcome: Twin Standard describes evidence-gated lifecycle transitions and modular, replay-safe evolution so implementations in any language can plan, apply, revert and verify changes against immutable lifecycle, module and source contracts
nonGoals: No modification of lifecycle, modularity or Twinstudio source repositories
No automatic execution of unapproved candidate changes or authority granted by an LLM
No provider-specific runtime, CAD engine, event store or deployment implementation
No claim that a proposal, score, simulation or generated artifact is verified evidence
No runtime dependency or language-specific SDK addition

architecture.decision: Extend the existing protobuf-first profile with immutable lifecycle and modularity references, evidence-gated transitions, revision-pinned candidate lineage, typed module-aware change plans, event-backed apply/revert and mandatory regeneration/readback; use Twinstudio only as pinned implementation evidence and preserve deterministic authority boundaries
dataChanges: The reference profile gains immutable source contracts plus lifecycle and evolutionary modularity policies
The protobuf model gains transport-neutral lifecycle transition and evolution plan/apply/revert views and events
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-005 before a stable Twin Standard release; existing v1 consumers remain identifiable by the prior profile version and contract hashes

validation.evidence: The profile pins full revisions and SHA-256 digests for lifecycle, modularity and Twinstudio source contracts
Mutation tests reject authority, replay, evidence, lineage, revision, queue, reversibility and module-graph violations with stable TWIN diagnostics
Lifecycle/evolution operations resolve to protobuf RPCs and bind exactly once to CLI, safe shell, REST and MCP
Host, networkless Docker and governance pass with five implementation files and no runtime dependencies
